scope: Owner-authorized restoration of hosted AI, a 50 USD allocation for 90 days within the existing 100 USD project ceiling, and reconciliation of unused old allocations

validation.initial_mac_attempts: Missing dependency downloads and sandbox-denied Unix sockets; pinned dependencies were fetched and the full suite passed outside the sandbox.

expired_allocation.rounding: Each charge rounded upward to whole USD micros; every request matches the broker ledger.

superseded_uninstalled_allocation.proof: Installation never attempted; current host still used the expired allocation and proposed run state files were absent.

deployment.method: Existing Ansible services role with new immutable native release; initialize only new broker run/capability databases
preserved: old broker databases and signed allocation
participant image and Rust FEAM artifact
archive lineage and private Mac archive-copy records
deployment.precheck_interruption: Initial precheck stopped before installation because an already-failed stopped broker retained failed status. Verified all six MainPIDs were zero, then resumed the same deployment. No initialization was replayed.

workspace_recovery.cause: Expired allocation prevented broker startup; missing model Unix socket made the workspace container exit, leaving its start outcome unknown.
workspace_recovery.procedure: Controller stopped; exact job and request hash reviewed; documented abort-job revoked capabilities and closed the uncertain job without replay.
workspace_recovery.user_browser_confirmation: Owner confirmed: Running; terminal and AI work

limitations: This restores the requested demo flow; full U.07 administrator grant/reset/revocation walkthrough remains pending.
No claim of unattended host reboot recovery: the on-demand connector remains disabled at boot.
The new 90-day expiry and dollar guards are validated in boundary tests; no 90-day endurance test was run.
